howto_body: ICE: the mean of Impact, Confidence and Ease, each 1–10, higher is better. Each value says where it comes from; one nobody knows leaves the score incomplete rather than guessed. Order puts a prerequisite before what needs it, and a tie stays a tie.

footer: The working set is kept with the project, for everyone who opens it; a confirmed order is a document in the repository and a record here. Confidence starts from what each requirement rests on — an assumption is a weak claim, a citation indirect evidence — and is yours to correct with what was observed.
